scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true });"
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:js && npm run build:bundle
scripts.test:all: npm run build && npm run test:engine && npm run test:ui
scripts.test:engine: tsx --test tests/binary-heap.test.ts tests/combo-utils.test.ts tests/lru-cache.test.ts tests/utils.test.ts tests/services.test.ts tests/error-paths.test.ts tests/integration.test.ts tests/integration-chart.test.ts tests/frontier-resumability.test.ts tests/prob-conservation.test.ts tests/engine-invariants.test.ts tests/tiered-aggregation.test.ts tests/worker-protocol.test.ts tests/engine.test.ts tests/registry.test.ts tests/data-integrity.test.ts tests/enchantment_physical.test.ts tests/book_mechanics.test.ts tests/mechanics_rules.test.ts tests/harvester.test.ts tests/instrumentation.test.ts tests/mass-accountant.test.ts
scripts.test:ui: playwright test tests/ui-basic.test.ts tests/ui-performance.test.ts tests/ui-chart.test.ts tests/ui-regression.test.ts
scripts.release: npm run test:all && npm run build:standalone
